BRS Leader Krishank Arrested Amid Allegations Against CM's Daughter

BRS leader Manne Krishank has been arrested in connection with allegations made against Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy's daughter. The Telangana High Court has granted Krishank arrest protection in a social media case. The specific details of the allegations and the social media case were not further elaborated in the provided coverage.
